question: Do seven strategy families not yet tested in this repository earn positive net returns on a broad crypto universe, in which market regimes, and does any of them improve the multi-premia blend?
registration_note: Declared 2026-10-01 before any result of these families on any coin. Parameters are textbook or round a-priori values; nothing is searched. Development sample = the 70 multi-premia-v1 coins; confirmation sample = the 60 multi-premia-untouched-holdout-v1 coins, evaluated once in the same run. Regime labels are defined here, before results, and are descriptive only (no regime filter is adopted from this study).
trial_family: strategy-zoo-v1 (7 families, one parameter set each)

design.dependence_cluster: calendar week (all coins share market moves)
design.design_effect_bps: not estimated; Newey-West 5 lags on daily portfolio returns

common.data: MEXC 8h OHLCV resampled to daily opens (00:00 UTC), 2020-06-01 to 2026-09-12, point-in-time universe (a coin enters once it has the lookback it needs)
common.execution: signal uses data up to the open of day d; trade at the open of d; return open(d) to open(d+1)
common.costs: 20 bps round trip on turnover; funding (Binance proxy) charged on held weights
common.cross_sectional_books: long top quartile / short bottom quartile at equal dollar weight, 0.5 gross each side, weekly rebalance (every 7th day), minimum 8 names

strategies.Z1_weekend: time series: hold the equal-weight basket long from the Friday 00:00 open to the Monday 00:00 open, flat otherwise (weekend effect)
strategies.Z2_btc_leadlag: time series: if BTC's previous-day return > +2%, hold the equal-weight alt basket (ex BTC) long for the day; if < -2%, short; else flat
strategies.Z3_residual_reversal: cross-sectional: score = minus the 7-day return residual after removing 60-day BTC beta x BTC's 7-day return (long the idiosyncratic losers, short the winners)
strategies.Z4_max_lottery: cross-sectional: score = minus the maximum single-day return over the last 30 days (short lottery-like coins)
strategies.Z5_high_proximity: cross-sectional: score = price / highest daily open over the last 180 days (long coins near their high)
strategies.Z6_volume_shock: cross-sectional: score = 7-day mean daily volume / 90-day mean daily volume (long abnormal-attention coins)
strategies.Z7_skewness: cross-sectional: score = minus the 60-day skewness of daily returns (long negative skew, short positive skew)

regimes.basis: equal-weight daily basket of the sample's coins, labels at day d use data before d only
regimes.trend_efficiency: Kaufman ER of the basket over 14 days, ranked against its prior 180 days: bottom tercile CHOP, top tercile TREND, else MIXED
regimes.volatility: 20-day realized basket vol above its prior 180-day median = HIGH_VOL, else LOW_VOL
regimes.direction: basket open above its 100-day mean = BULL, else BEAR

pass_rules.development: mean > 0, Newey-West t >= 2.0, Sharpe > 0 in both halves
pass_rules.confirmation: Sharpe > 0 and Newey-West t >= 1.5 on the 60 untouched coins
pass_rules.multiple_testing: seven families are tested; results with development t < 2.7 (Bonferroni at 5% for 7 tests) are labelled as not surviving correction even if they pass
pass_rules.blend_addition: descriptive only: 4-leg equal-risk blend vs the 3-leg multi-premia blend on both samples

if_passed: a family that passes development and confirmation may be registered as a forward watch; nothing is promoted and the multi-premia-blend-v1 watch is unchanged
